newScripts.test:coverage-enhanced: npm run test:enhanced && npm run test:quality
newScripts.test:performance-monitor: npm run test:performance && node -r ts-node/register tests/monitoring/test-quality-monitor.ts
newScripts.test:security-enhanced: npm run test:security && npm run security:audit && npm run test:quality
newScripts.test:full-suite: npm run test:enhanced && npm run test:quality && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:performance && npm run test:security
newScripts.test:ci-enhanced: npm run test:smart && npm run test:quality && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
newScripts.test:data:generate: node -e "const factory = require('./tests/factories/enhanced-test-data-factory.ts'); const data = factory.generateCompleteWorkshopEcosystem({ userCount: 50, workshopCount: 10 }); console.log(JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));" > test-data.json
newScripts.test:data:validate: node -r ts-node/register -e "const factory = require('./tests/factories/enhanced-test-data-factory.ts'); console.log('Test data factory working correctly');"
